name: Roosteroverzicht Traffic Bridge
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if ! curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then nohup npm --prefix bridge start >/tmp/traffic-bridge.log 2>&1 & fi; sleep 2; if command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -n "$CODESPACE_NAME" ]; then gh codespace ports visibility 8787:public -c "$CODESPACE_NAME" || true; fi'
